# Flower Studio by Pushpraj

> Flower Studio is Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula's premier luxury florist and wholesale floral supplier, handcrafting fresh flower bouquets, bespoke gift hampers, artisan eggless cakes, indoor plants, and spiritual pooja essentials with express same-day and midnight delivery.

## Overview

Serving the Tricity region since 1985 from Sector 29D, Chandigarh, Flower Studio operates both as an elite retail florist and as a wholesale flower distributor. Customers can order online through the website, via the Android mobile application on Google Play, or directly through the WhatsApp concierge helpline for retail gifting or wholesale bulk orders.

- **Brand Name**: Flower Studio by Pushpraj
- **Flagship Studio & Wholesale Desk**: Sco-52, Sector 29D, Chandigarh, 160030, India (Sector 29 Flower Market Hub)
- **Retail Delivery Coverage**: All sectors of Chandigarh (160001 - 160071), Mohali (SAS Nagar), Panchkula, and Zirakpur
- **Wholesale Supply Coverage**: Bulk floral delivery across Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh & Chandigarh Tricity
- **Delivery Timings**: Daily 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM; Midnight delivery available on request (11:30 PM – 12:15 AM)
- **Delivery Speed**: 60-minute express delivery for bouquets & scheduled time slots
- **WhatsApp Support (Retail & Wholesale)**: [+91 93354 01435](https://wa.me/919335401435) / [+91 98720 05054](https://wa.me/919872005054)
- **Phone Helplines**: +91 98154 93338, +91 98720 05054, +91 93354 01435
- **Official Email**: flowerstudiobypushpraj@gmail.com

## Retail & Wholesale Floral Services

### 1. Retail Luxury Gifting
- **Fresh Bouquets**: Handcrafted Dutch red roses, Asiatic lilies, orchids, and carnation stems wrapped in premium matte sheets or styled in clear glass vases.
- **Custom Gift Hampers**: Gourmet hampers filled with imported chocolates, teddy bears, dry fruits, and personalized greeting cards.
- **100% Eggless Cakes**: Chocolate Truffle, Black Forest, Red Velvet, and Fruit Cakes baked fresh for birthdays and anniversaries.
- **Indoor Greenery**: Air-purifying Peace Lilies, Ficus Bonsai trees, Money Plants, and Jade succulents in ceramic planters.
- **Express & Midnight Delivery**: Hand-delivered within 60 minutes across Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula.

### 2. Wholesale Flower Supply & Mandi Distribution
- **Bulk Cut Flowers**: Fresh roses by bundle, carnations, gerberas, lilies, gypsophila (baby's breath), and chrysanthemums.
- **Wedding & Event Decorators**: Mandap flowers, stage backdrop florals, entrance arch flowers, and exotic imported foliage at mandi rates.
- **Pooja & Temple Wholesale**: Loose marigolds (*genda phool*), yellow and orange marigold garlands, lotus blossoms, and loose rose petals for rituals.
- **B2B Supply**: Daily and weekly contracted floral supply for 5-star hotels, banquet halls, corporates, and local florists.
